channel.description_html:
An independent developer's journal featuring updates on my projects, open-source tools, new releases, experiments, and everything happening behind the scenes.

Built with curiosity, creativity, and a little help from AI.

posts.text_html:
Another project I want to introduce is KotoClicker, an open-source autoclicker for Windows. 🐱

The idea was simple: create a convenient tool for automating repetitive mouse and keyboards actions, without unnecessary complexity.

But I also wanted to give it some personality. That's how a lazy ginger cat and its little mouse sidekick became the face of KotoClicker.

Underneath the cute appearance is a capable automation tool with automatic clicking, scrolling, drag & drop, macro recording and playback, customizable hotkeys and more.

The project is fully offline and open-source under the GNU GPL v3 license. No telemetry, no unnecessary background processes, and your macros stay on your computer.

A small utility that grew into a project of its own.

One of the first projects I want to introduce here is DownGrab.

The idea behind it was simple: make downloading videos and audio as easy as sending a message on Telegram.

No need to search for third-party websites, install extra software, or deal with complicated interfaces.

Just send a link to @DownGrabBot, and the bot will process it and deliver the file directly to your chat.

A simple idea that grew into a much bigger project.

More about its development, features, and updates soon!
